set.body: Fold MapSimilarityMethod, the StudyMethod cosine route and ScanpathComparison into one descriptor-backed comparison registry preserving Metric/Kernel typing; move eyesim-compat variants (fromReference, FisherZLegacy, fisherZMachineEpsilon) into an eyesim compatibility object; remove uninhabited public cases (ScanpathComponent.PositionEmd) until an instance exists; unify TemplateFit/LearnedTemplate/SurfaceDecomposition fitting families and their three recipe codecs; move ResultTable/ResultFamily into a pure module and retire TidyResult, per-family CSV objects and BaselineExports behind it. Re-record the API inventory once afterwards.
set.title: CR2: one comparison registry, one template family, one pure result-table layer
